```{python import-custom-functions}
import diff_df # these are custom functions from diff_df.py
```

```{python make-diff-table-tabs}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

for i in comparisons:
    diff_list = diff_df.find_differences(comparisons[i]['original'], comparisons[i]['changed'], 'a-to-b')
    
    diff_summary = diff_df.summarize_differences('a-to-b')
    
    deleted = diff_df.deleted_rows(diff_list, comparisons[i]['original'])
    inserted = diff_df.inserted_rows(diff_list, comparisons[i]['changed'])
    updated = diff_df.changed_rows(diff_list, comparisons[i]['original'])
    
    print('# ' + comparisons[i]['name'] + '\n\n')
    print('::: {.panel-tabset} \n\n')
    print('## Summary\n\n')
    
    if diff_summary is not None:
        show(diff_summary)
    
    print('\n\n## Deleted Rows\n\n')
    
    if len(deleted) > 0:
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in deleted:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(deleted[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    else:
        print("No deleted rows")
    
    print('\n\n## Inserted Rows\n\n')
    
    if len(inserted) > 0:
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in inserted:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(inserted[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    else:
        print("No inserted rows")
    
    print('\n\n## Updated Rows\n\n')
    
    if len(updated) > 0:
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in updated:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(updated[j], allow_html = True)
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    else:
        print("No updated rows")
    
    print('\n\n:::')
```
